# Style 3: Wildcard (Risograph)

> made with friends.

**The feel:** friendly, handmade, a bit artsy, like a zine.

Start with [`overview.png`](overview.png) (everything on one sheet) and the brand guide in [`01_Brand-Guide/`](01_Brand-Guide/).

## Colours

| | Name | HEX | RGB | Share of a layout |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| signature | Ultramarine Ink | `#2C46B8` | 44, 70, 184 | about 25 % |
| second | Hot Coral Ink | `#FF5E4D` | 255, 94, 77 | about 10 % |
| light | Cream Paper | `#F1E8D6` | 241, 232, 214 | about 60 % |
| dark | Ink Blue-Black | `#14182E` | 20, 24, 46 | about 5 % |

## Type

- **Anton** (Regular) for the name, titles and big lines.
- **Space Grotesk** (Regular, Medium, Bold) for small labels and anything you read.
- Both are free for commercial use. See `../fonts.md`.

## Sound

Print-press thunks, paper slaps, rubber stamps and a soft mallet chime. Every intro ends on the two-note ASTRIS motif, in this style's voice.

## Rules

- Two inks on cream paper: ultramarine blue for the lettering, hot coral behind it as a soft offset shadow.
- Where the inks overlap they go a deep violet-brown. That is the look: let it happen.
- The coral plate sits 1 to 3 px out of register on purpose, like a real risograph print.
